body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Victorinox(www.swissarmy.com) introduced its new Swiss Army knife 'Victorinox Secure' with LED backlight during CES 2010, which comes with USB flash memory available in 8GB, 16GB and 32GB.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
